tools.name: account.budget.checkReserve
tools.title: Account budget: check reserve

mcp.name: Account budget: check reserve
mcp.description: Whether reserve with the same parameters would fit now, here and in every enclosing scope, after the reservations of a lease that is no longer active are settled, as reserve settles them; it changes nothing and does not ask for a lease. Queue copies its answer so that a claim that cannot fit is not tried.

tools.name: account.budget.observe
tools.title: Account budget: observe

mcp.name: Account budget: observe
mcp.description: Records the usage of a meter a provider reports, in place of what the meter counts until resetsAt (until the meter's next reset without it, and until the next observe for a meter with no reset): the meter's used is the figure given, usage recorded after it adds to it, and limit, when given, is the meter's limit while it holds. Nothing passes up to an enclosing scope. Needs observePermission. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

tools.name: account.budget.recordUsage
tools.title: Account budget: record usage

mcp.name: Account budget: record usage
mcp.description: Records usage of a meter, which is never refused. The part of it the instance's own reservation covers is released, here and in every enclosing scope, and the usage counts in each of them. Reports every instance of the chain whose usage is over its limit after it, moves the status of each whose config gives escalate, and sends onExceeded's directive to the holder of the active lease once per meter per lease.

tools.name: account.budget.reserve
tools.title: Account budget: reserve

mcp.name: Account budget: reserve
mcp.description: Reserves an amount of one meter, or of every meter the config gives a reservation, for the instance and every enclosing scope. Refused when the instance or an enclosing scope cannot fit it, and then nothing is reserved anywhere. On a type that composes Lease it needs an active lease, and the reservation is settled when that lease ends.

mcp.name: Job lease: acquire
mcp.description: Takes the lease for the caller and returns its fencing token. Refused while a lease is active, the caller's own included (heartbeat renews it), without acquirePermission when the config names one, and once the instance has had maxExpiries expiries. Over a lease that expired, it applies that expiry first.

tools.name: job.lease.direct
tools.title: Job lease: direct

mcp.name: Job lease: direct
mcp.description: Sends the holder of the active lease a directive, which its heartbeats deliver until it acknowledges it. With dedupeKey, a directive already sent under the lease with the key is not sent again. A principal needs directPermission, or overridePermission when that is absent, and is refused when the config names neither; another behavior of the type sends one with call(), as the principal it runs for, without either.

tools.name: job.lease.expire
tools.title: Job lease: expire

mcp.name: Job lease: expire
mcp.description: Applies the expiry of a lease past its expiry time or its longest hold: the holder is cleared, the token advances, the expiry is counted unless the instance is in a terminal state of its Workflow, and onExpiry or escalate moves the status. Any principal who may write the instance may call it; on any other instance it changes nothing. With holder, a principal with overridePermission expires that holder's lease at once, active or not, unless notRenewedAfter spares it. The engine's runner calls it on every lapsed lease, every sweepMs.

mcp.description: Renews the lease, never past its longest hold, acknowledges the directives acknowledge names, and returns the directives sent under it that are not acknowledged. Only the holder, presenting the current token as Lease's precondition, while the lease is active: an expired lease cannot be renewed.

tools.name: job.lease.release
tools.title: Job lease: release

mcp.name: Job lease: release
mcp.description: Ends an active lease: the holder, presenting the current token as Lease's precondition, or a principal with overridePermission, who need not. The token advances, so the directives sent under the lease are not delivered again, and onExpiry moves the status when it is still one of its from states. With abandon, the holder gives the work up as failed: the release counts as an expiry, and escalate applies at the one that reaches maxExpiries.

tools.name: job.retries.recordAttempt
tools.title: Job retries: record attempt

mcp.name: Job retries: record attempt
mcp.description: Records an attempt: a success without failure, or a failure of one of the config's classes, counted against its caps, and returns the class's hint. Decides whether its result is kept, and writes a kept result to resultField. Exhausts the instance at a terminal class, a failure past a cap or a stuck signature, moving its status to exhaustedState from the from states. Refused once the instance is exhausted, and without the config's permission.

mcp.description: Applies the miss of an instance past its deadline and not missed yet: sets missed, moves the status with onMissed when it is one of its from states, and expires the principal's leases on the releaseLeases schemas that were not renewed after its last beat, recording which in released.
